I wrote the reply to `reply.txt` in the run folder. It follows the rules in `VOICE.md`: 60 words or fewer, short sentences, no markdown, links or shorthand, and an offer of more detail at the end. The tools come from the Tools section of `FACTS.md`.

The spoken reply:

> Shauna works mostly with Claude Code and Figma. For building sites she uses Astro, React and TypeScript. Supabase handles data, and she deploys with Vercel and Netlify. Want the details on how they fit together?

`FACTS.md` only lists the tools. It doesn't say which ones she uses most, what each is for, or how they fit together. So "mostly", "building sites", "handles data" and "deploys with" are my inferences. The offer of "details on how they fit together" goes beyond what the file covers, so you may want to change or drop it.
